title: Consent Signal Read
description: One run of the consent gate, recorded BEFORE the interaction so the prediction can be checked afterwards. The doctrine that a failed gate stops the mode, and that a soft no routes to disengagement rather than to a second attempt, is enforced here by the schema itself: a record carrying a failed gate, an answered question, or any disengagement signal cannot also carry a proceed verdict. No third party is identifiable in this file. The only person field is a single given name, and the context is a generic category rather than a place.

person_ref.description: The only permitted representation of the other person. There is deliberately no field for a surname, workplace, address, handle, profile, phone, email or photo, and additionalProperties is false so none can be added.

first_name.description: A single given name or an initial. The pattern rejects whitespace, digits and punctuation, so a full name, an email or a handle cannot be written here.

context.description: A generic category. There is no free-text venue field, so a real person's regular places cannot be recorded.

relation.description: Several of these fail gate 1 on their own

gate_cheap_refusal.description: True when they can say no cheaply here. False for structural power, professional duty of care, captivity, service asymmetry, a stated partner, or significant intoxication.

gate_already_answered.description: True when they have NOT already answered, so the gate passes. False when any refusal is already on the record.

gate_survives_knowing.description: True when the move survives them knowing exactly what it is

gate_reading_not_inventing.description: True when the read rests on the observed column rather than on inference alone

signals_observed.description: Only what a camera would have caught

disengagement_signals.description: Each is a full answer at full strength with no discount for ambiguity. Any entry here forces a stop verdict.

inference.description: Everything not in signals_observed, held here so it stays labelled as inference

disconfirming_evidence.description: What would show this read is wrong. Mandatory, because a read with no falsifier is a hope.

constraint.description: Named constraint when the verdict is proceed_with_constraint, for example one ask, dropped on anything short of a clear yes

failed_gate.description: Which gate failed and why, absent when all four passed

alternative_offered.description: The honest alternative offered on a stop: a different context, one legible low-pressure statement of interest, or a clean exit

allOf.description: One failed gate stops the mode. There is no majority vote and no averaging, so a record with any gate false cannot carry a proceed verdict.
A soft no is a full no. A disinterest read routes to graceful disengagement, never to a persistence tactic.
Any observed disengagement signal is an answer, so the record cannot express proceeding past it.
A constraint must be named when the verdict is proceed_with_constraint.
